zeroconf.title: EISUS device discovered
zeroconf.description: Add the EISUS device at {name}? You will need its local access token.

user.title: EISUS device
user.description: Enter the device address and its local access token. The device answers on the LAN only; the token is issued by the EISUS platform and stored on the device itself.

reauth_confirm.title: EISUS token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The device at {host} rejected the stored local token. Enter the current token.

init.title: EISUS device connection
init.description: Update the address or the local token of this device.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Send a raw JSON payload to one of the device's local HTTP endpoints (advanced use, e.g. full schedule upload).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EISUS device to send the command to.

endpoint.name: Endpoint
endpoint.description: cmd (outputs and configuration), timer, schedule or time.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: JSON object matching the firmware command schema.

set_time.name: Set device time
set_time.description: Set the device clock. Defaults to the current Home Assistant time, which keeps schedules and timers working without internet (no NTP).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EISUS device to set the clock on.

use_now.name: Use current time
use_now.description: Push the current Home Assistant time (default).

epoch.name: Epoch
epoch.description: Unix timestamp to set instead of the current time.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name stored on the device.

set_schedule.name: Set weekly schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace every weekly schedule rule on the device (empty list clears the schedule).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EISUS device to upload the schedule to.

rules.name: Rules
rules.description: List of rules: days (list or bitmask), start, end, outputs.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel timers
cancel_timer.description: Cancel the running timer or pulse of one output, or of every output when none is given.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EISUS device to cancel timers on.

output.name: Output
output.description: Output number (1-4); omit for all outputs.

calibrate_shutter.name: Calibrate shutter
calibrate_shutter.description: Start/end interactive shutter calibration or set the travel times directly (open_time_ms / close_time_ms).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EISUS shutter device to calibrate.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: start = enter calibration, end = store and leave.

action.name: Action
action.description: Jog the motor: open, stop or close.
